_about: Image inventory for theluxuryliners.com (assets track). One record per file or Flickr photo. Masters are never served as-is: export resized sRGB WebP/AVIF/JPEG. Paths are relative to the repo root. Companion document: research/05-assets-and-photos.md.

quality_tiers.print-ok: >= 2400px long edge (about 8 in at 300 dpi); retina hero
quality_tiers.covers: 3000px = distributor/print spec; 1400-1600px = web, and CD-booklet print (4.75 in) at about 300 dpi

credit_rules: R1: no licence requests; publish with the photographer credit where known.
P17: credit line format "Photo: Name". Photos taken by the band, family or a self-timer carry no credit line. The credit gate is closed: uncredited photos publish with no credit line.

credit_status tells the build what to do: "named-credit-confirmed" = show the credit; "named-credit-awaiting-confirmation" = a photographer is named only on Flickr (album/title/description), show it after Carly confirms the spelling/attribution in one pass; "no-credit-publishable (P17)" = publish with no credit line; cover-art records use the P40 line.
P40: cover art carries "Cover art: all rights reserved by the rights holders."
P22: the 2002 four-piece photo has no credit.
caption_rules: P23: the 2002 photo caption is exactly "David Wilstermann, Chad Edgington, David Dewese and Scott Carpenter in 2002"; never "the 2002 line-up".

F4: David Dewese and Chad Edgington co-founded the band in 1997; Chad left Nashville in 2001. Photos from 1997 to early 2001 may say "with co-founder Chad Edgington". Photos from after Chad left may show him only as a forever member (P8) or a guest (e.g. the 2002 photo of all four, P23; the Royse City duo 4470275899), never as part of the current line-up. Trio-era photos (2001-) show David Dewese, Scott Carpenter and David "Larry" Wilstermann.

P14: name people where a source supports it; anything marked "(confirm)" in `people` needs Carly before it appears in a caption. Name only band members and credited guests in band roles; never name audience, friends, family or children.
P8: Wilstermann may be called David "Larry" Wilstermann; explain the nickname once, on the band page.
Former members (LaFrate, Winchester, Kyle Edgington, Jeffries): band role only, and only after the consent question (research 01 Q10).
Third-party likenesses (another band's press photo, film stills, cardboard cut-outs, ballet posters) stay archive-only and are never presented as Luxury Liners photos.
Flyers: caption with venue and date as printed; inferred years are marked "probably".
P27: "Shake It Up" is an original first released on the Believe EP (2001); the 2021 single is a live version.
Unused covers: caption "Unused cover design" + designer credit where known (Mark Montgomery).
X1: one excluded side project and person never appear in any file, caption, alt text or question. IDs in do_not_use_ids are never used and need no follow-up.
Privacy: no current homes, workplaces or family details of Chad Edgington, Scott Carpenter, David Wilstermann or anyone else in any caption or alt text.
Shared bills: frames of other acts (e.g. Jeff Grant, Oct 2007; the Codaphonic frames) are never captioned as The Luxury Liners; check the "performer" field where present.
Reunion / later photos: The Luxury Liners never broke up (F6: 2026 singles). Never call a member "former" when he is a forever member (P8).
